hs_target_relation.source: Recorded stationary pregrasp cup velocity near numerical zero; 0.005 m/s is a project simulation proxy for static classification, not a safety speed limit. Exclude only with explicit pregrasp/grasp phase, no prior close/attach or bilateral grip in complete contact history, and measured speed at or below this value. Include if moving or once grip/attach begins; unknown otherwise. Version v2 also treats a complete empty Pick skill trace before its first command as pregrasp evidence, provided contact history is complete and the target is measured stationary; this resolves the v2r4 AH startup unknown/hold loop.
